Job Description Generative AI Engineer

Experience: 5–8 Years
Location: Yelahanka, Bangalore
Work Model: Work from Office – 4 Days per Week

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Generative AI Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Python, Azure AI Foundry/Azure Stack, LangChain, and LangGraph. The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, statistical modeling, and model validation, with the ability to build, evaluate, and optimize AI/GenAI solutions.

Mandatory Skills

Strong hands-on experience in Python
Hands-on experience with Generative AI
Mandatory experience with Azure AI Foundry / Azure Stack
Strong experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph
Experience in developing and integrating LLM-based applications
Strong understanding of Machine Learning
Hands-on experience in Model Validation and Performance Evaluation
Experience with Statistical Modeling and Forecasting
Hands-on experience with Reinforcement Learning

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI solutions using Python and Azure AI services.
Build LLM-powered applications using LangChain and LangGraph.
Work with Azure AI Foundry/Azure Stack for model development, orchestration, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop and optimize AI/ML models for enterprise use cases.
Implement model validation, benchmarking, performance evaluation, and monitoring.
Apply statistical modeling and forecasting techniques to business and technical problems.
Develop and evaluate Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning models.
Perform prompt engineering, model evaluation, and optimization of LLM-based solutions.
Design AI workflows, agents, and multi-step orchestration using LangGraph/LangChain.
Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Ensure solutions meet standards for accuracy, scalability, reliability, security, and performance.

Required Technical Expertise

Candidate Profile

5–8 years of relevant experience in AI/ML, Data Science, Generative AI, or related engineering roles.
Strong programming and problem-solving skills in Python.
Proven hands-on experience building production-grade GenAI/LLM applications.
Strong understanding of ML algorithms, model evaluation, and statistical techniques.
Experience working with cloud-based AI platforms, particularly the Azure ecosystem.
Ability to independently design, develop, test, and deploy AI solutions.

Work Location

Yelahanka, Bangalore – Work from Office 4 days per week.

Important: Candidates must be comfortable working from the Yelahanka office as per the required work model.
